STEP 3 OF 8

Routing

Choose how participants are sequenced and whether they act simultaneously or one at a time.

Sequential — one step at a time

Need named stages and per-person requirements?

After this document exists, its Signing Workflow tab can turn the routing order below into named stages — each with an explicit required action and an individual electronic signature requirement for every person. Routing configured here keeps working on its own, and nothing here depends on Workflow Automation.

NEEDS ATTENTION

• At least one routing step must be configured.
• Participant "LAGDA Local Review Recipient" is required but has not been assigned to a routing step.
Routing mode
Parallel — everyone at once
All participants in each routing group may act simultaneously, without waiting for one another.
Sequential — one step at a time
Each routing step begins only after all required participants in the previous step complete their actions.
Mixed — groups, each in parallel
Multiple participants may act in parallel within ordered routing steps.
Approval-based — approve before sign
An Approver or Reviewer step must complete before later signing or acknowledgment steps begin.
